title: Italy's antitrust authority says it reduced the record fine imposed on Amazon in 2021, from €1.13B to €752M, after a recalculation (Elvira Pollina/Reuters)
summary: Elvira Pollina / Reuters: Italy's antitrust authority says it reduced the record fine imposed on Amazon in 2021, from €1.13B to €752M, after a recalculation — Italy's antitrust authority said on Monday it had reduced a record fine imposed on U.S e-commerce giant Amazon (AMZN.O) to 752.4 million euros …
